title: A pattern's definition
description: What every patterns/<name>/<name>.json says about its pattern: a whole screen, as the app arranges it, put together from the library's components. Its HTML is beside it, in patterns/<name>/<name>.html.

purpose.description: What the screen is for, in a sentence or two.

when.description: When to use it, each a situation in a journey, so someone choosing between patterns can match theirs.

avoid.description: When it's the wrong pattern, and what to use instead.

instead.description: What to use instead: another pattern, by name, or a component, or a few words.

components.description: The library's components it uses, by element name. The build checks these are exactly the ones its HTML uses.

screen.description: Which of the app's screens it is taken from, in words, such as "Settings, the Settings tab".

sources.description: The app's screens it was taken from, in the iOS and Android source, and anything else. The same shape as a component's.

notes.description: Anything else to know when using it, such as what to change in its HTML.
